comment: Provider USD prices behind the yearly hosting tiers. Manual file — review ~quarterly or when a provider changes rates. Planning rate and rounding live in scripts/update-hosting-prices.mjs.
planning_rate_source: Price list v1.0 (Final), issued 29 Sep 2026: NGN 1,400 per USD 1 (official ~1,330, open-market ~1,390 on 28 Sep 2026; planning rate covers card charges)
domain_note: Domain is included in each tier's USD figure; the 40,000 NGN domain line on the site stays fixed (registry prices rarely move).
